native_name: 株式会社小松製作所 (brand コマツ; Komatsu Ltd.)

selection.reason: Japan's maker of the JGSDF Type 96 wheeled APC, Light Armored Vehicle and Type 87 reconnaissance vehicle, and a leading civilian construction and mining machinery manufacturer. The game has no Japanese ground supplier, so this dossier gives a Japanese wheeled-vehicle identity without duplicating MHI's tanks.

existing_game_references.note: Generated fictional contractors only; no Komatsu reference exists in game data.

summary: Komatsu (registered name 株式会社小松製作所, founded 1921) kept its name through the window. It bought Partek Forest (Sweden) in 2004, sold control of Komatsu Electronic Metals in 2006, introduced autonomous haulage and a hybrid excavator in 2008, bought Joy Global (US) in 2017, absorbed Komatsu Tokki in 2018 and moved Smart Construction to EARTHBRAIN in 2021. Its defence line built the Type 96 APC and the Light Armored Vehicle; the Wheeled Armored Vehicle (Improved) prototype contract of 2015 was discontinued in 2018, and in 2022 the Ministry of Defense chose a foreign design as the Type 96 successor. Its FY2025 report still lists ammunition and armoured personnel carriers.

proposed.uncertainty: The Type 96 is a wheeled APC matching the game's wheeled carrier envelope, which is generic. Komatsu's own successor was cancelled in 2018 and Japan chose a foreign design in 2022, so any later Komatsu APC line would be fictional.
The Type 87 equips reconnaissance units and the LAV infantry and reconnaissance units; neither is a replica of the game scout, and the Type 87 design predates 1990.
Komatsu ammunition calibres and types were not sourced; artillery ammunition is attested only in general terms.
Generated contractors are fictional; a real identity would replace one generated manufacturing contractor.
Komatsu makes construction machinery rather than performing construction work; construction contractors speed funded projects.

duplicates_avoided: The Suwa (Nagano) company with the identical trade name is a different legal person.
Patria's AMV (selected 2022) is not a Komatsu product; the other finalist was an MHI prototype, not recorded as an MHI product.
Komatsu is not proposed for the Japan:air_light_attack supplier programme.
Komatsu Electronic Metals (now SUMCO TECHXIV) and Komatsu Mining Corp. are separate legal persons.

integration_flow.summary: A later, reviewed integration could attach this sourced identity to a company created through the existing orders. Design stays with the commissioning country; Defense R&D pays development as work is performed; the company funds tooling, national-warehouse inputs and fabrication from its own settled cash; the buyer purchases whole finished units from company stock; delivery follows fiscal settlement and seven accessible days. Ammunition would use the existing AmmoSupply, AmmoInventory and AmmoPurchase orders for a licensed family from the same company, not a new route.

steps.note: Paid capitalisation from Defense procurement (political capital price applies); leases one existing completed Arms Plant slot. No historical factory, balance or stock is granted.
Further paid working capital; unsettled receivables are not spendable cash.
Frozen design revision; Defense R&D pays engineering, prototype and trials work day by day; prototypes are never saleable.
Finite company-owned stock target (0-12 units); a target is never a government order.
Government buys whole units from existing company stock; settlement then seven accessible delivery days.

unmapped: Autonomous haulage, hybrid excavators, mining and forestry machinery: no machinery product consumer.

gaps: The Type 96 and LAV service-entry years were not found in official sources; only as-of observations and a 2010 white-paper column are recorded.
Komatsu's reported 2019 withdrawal from developing new defence vehicles is news-only.

future_policy.note: Nothing after the frozen cutoff is predicted. Any later product, successor or business in a campaign must be authored as explicitly fictional game content (labelled "(fictional)") or left unknown.
